evidence.title: The Making of Cursor's Icons – Minor Adventures

name: The Making of Cursor's Icons
summary: Case study of designing an icon system of 600+ icons in two sizes and two styles, every variant drawn by hand over a year.
description: A designer's write-up of drawing, testing and shipping a complete icon set for a coding agent: redrawing a drifted 468-icon inherited library, finding the right stroke weights (1.25px at 16px, 1.5px at 24px), outline and filled styles, optical shapes, consistency rules, and delivering the result as an icon font that replaced the old one without breaking a single reference.
contains: 600+ icons in two sizes and two styles
shipped as an icon font replacing the previous set
